actions.action: Set up a weekly watering routine, letting the soil dry slightly between waterings
Poke into the soil to check moisture an inch or two down before watering
Drizzle water evenly over the whole soil surface
If the soil is caked or water runs off, poke holes in the top couple of inches with a chopstick or pencil
Feed with diluted seaweed extract about every 3 months
Alternatively feed with an aloe vera soil drench
Alternatively feed with homemade actively aerated compost tea

verdict.reason: This generic care article blames overwatering and never diagnoses the hunger; feeding is only a buried general-care section, and nothing in it is likely to harm the plant.
